_doc: Embedders for the dense comparison (eval/sweep.py --embedders, EXP-003, H-30). Facts checked 2026-11-19 on huggingface.co (api/models/<id>?blobs=true and the model card): params from the safetensors index (bge-m3: estimated from the fp32 weight file), weights_mb = the one weight file sentence-transformers loads, sr = the card lists Serbian. proto_prefix goes before every prototype phrase, text_prefix before every listing. mx130: fits a 2 GB GPU in fp32 with room for a small batch, otherwise run on CPU. groups in this file (multilingual, english) select unique model ids for ci/cache_model.py and scripts/download_embedders.py. Excluded: Alibaba-NLP/gte-multilingual-base (trust_remote_code, the code lives in another repo, Alibaba-NLP/new-impl), jinaai/jina-embeddings-v3 (cc-by-nc-4.0 and trust_remote_code), classla/bcms-bertic, classla/xlm-r-bertic, jerteh/Jerteh-355 (fill-mask encoders, not sentence embedders).
